restoration.method: Inverse hashline edits in the scratch clone, including moving the original saved revision-check block back for spanfirst; no lane production edits.

mutants.expected_detector: [INFERENCE] No kill: lowercase-only validation plus lowercase sha256sum output make this comparison-only mutant equivalent on these inputs.
mutants.verdict: Survived; [INFERENCE] equivalent after canonical validation, not demonstrated as a coverage gap. Uppercase acceptance was not introduced.

mutants.name: spanfirst
mutants.change: Move the revision-check block after the existing span check and hash only when observed != unsupported, so an absent span wins over a stale pin.
mutants.expected_detector: S4_mismatch_span_absent; [INFERENCE] the aggregate claims-sha-stale selftest assertions may survive.
mutants.verdict: Killed by the counter; selftest-only precedence coverage gap. The inspected selftest requires generic observed=stale and a first-claim finding, not a stale verdict for every individual T claim.

command_templates.resource_caps: 2 GiB address space, 4096 processes; maximum three synchronous detector subprocesses; started process groups killed/reaped before return.

evidence_naming: <mutant>.patch and .mutant.sh preserve each single mutation. <stage>.<seed>.run.json records actual command, exit, before/after gate hashes, counter hash and stdout/stderr paths. Counter receipts preserve all per-class scores and misses. <stage>.selftest.stdout preserves every case. Stages are pristine, <mutant>.mutated, and <mutant>.restored.
limits: No network; no tool install/update; no parser mutation; no direct sha256sum fault injection; synthetic-fixture measurements only. A survivor does not change P2 or the contract. No baseline failure, timeout or inconclusive detector result occurred. Failed setup at process cap 256 is disclosed in probe-plan.json and was not scored.
